resources.name: Medical baseline: 4 most-critical no-answers
resources.notes: 4 households are on the list of the 40 most critical. No answer after 3 retries. A door visit is required and no crew is assigned yet. They are NOT counted as reached.

resources.name: Stonebridge Assisted Living (KS-04): direct call
resources.notes: Direct call still pending. The administrator called in at 05:24: 40 residents, 12 non-ambulatory, 4 on oxygen concentrators. She asks for a yes or no on the shutoff. If power could be out until Friday, she must book wheelchair vans now. Callback owed.

resources.name: Pine Gulch Water District Well 2: direct call
resources.notes: Pending. No answer yet from the district on-call operator. Most callers in the queue are asking about Well 2.

resources.name: Cell tower PG-14: direct call
resources.notes: Pending. Waiting on the carrier NOC callback about the site's backup power runtime.

resources.name: 911 / Regional Communications Center
resources.notes: The 72h and 24h direct calls are done. The at-shutoff script is held until the 06:00 decision. If it's a go, Circuits 6, 7, 11 and 12 go dead at 08:00 for 24 to 48 hours. RCC asked to confirm its backup generator test.

resources.name: Critical facility direct calls (14 listed)
resources.notes: 11 of 14 complete. 3 still pending: PG-14, Stonebridge and Well 2.

resources.name: Medical baseline households on affected circuits (71)
resources.notes: 62 confirmed contacts. 9 no-answers after 3 retries: 4 critical (door visit, see top row) and 5 not on the critical list.

resources.name: Customer care queue
resources.notes: 47 callers waiting. Most ask about Well 2 water service and whether the Pine Gulch Fire Station community room opens at 07:00.

resources.name: Community Resource Center: Pine Gulch Fire Station community room
resources.notes: Advertised hours 07:00-21:00 with charging, water and a warming area. Opening depends on the 06:00 decision.

resources.name: De-energization decision: Circuits 6, 7, 11, 12
resources.notes: Due 06:00 from Operations. Planned de-energization 08:00 if approved. Affects 3,100 customers.

resources.name: At-shutoff notices (customers, partners, critical facilities)
resources.notes: Drafted and held. Not released until the Operations decision is logged.

resources.name: Partner notices, 72h and 24h
resources.notes: Sent to county EM, Sheriff, fire districts, water district, hospital, school district and carriers.

resources.name: Customer notices, 48h and 12h
resources.notes: Sent by text, email and automated call to all customers on Circuits 6, 7, 11 and 12.

resources.name: Pine Gulch Medical Center: direct call
resources.notes: Confirmed. Oxygen reserve full and on-site generator ready.

legend.yellow: In progress or waiting on the 06:00 decision

instructorNote: Hand the board to OPS and DISP, then voice the agent's and the Stonebridge administrator's calls. Watch whether OPS makes and logs the 06:00 decision against the Plan 3 thresholds, assigns door visits without counting the 4 as reached, and closes out the PG-14, Stonebridge and Well 2 calls. Watch whether DISP confirms the generator and treats the lines as energized until the co-op verifies them. After 06:00, play Version A (go: "It's a go for 08:00. I need the door-visit crews assigned to the 4 critical no-answers before then.") or Version B (delay: "3,100 customers and 14 critical facilities were told 08:00. Do we send a postponement notice, and what time do we give them for the next decision?").
